piggyback_latency.note: provisional objective: nearest-rank p99 of request-to-response (rt_us, master request on out.pcap to response on in.pcap, the same Vision NIC clock) over piggybacked exchanges <= pb + margin; up to 1% of samples may exceed it, so it is not a maximum guarantee. fixture.note: Two workloads, run and reported separately. separate_ack = vision_run.py casea on --delay-ms delay_ms (emulated relay: a separate ACK, then a delayed response, as the SEL-751 does). piggyback = casea off (the endpoint's natural ~0.3 ms response with the ACK on the response). readiness must exceed delay_ms + readiness_margin_ms or the delayed child response misses the readiness deadline (audit defect D); that is a warning. jitter is not implemented by vision_run.py, so any non-zero jitter_ms is rejected.

traffic.master_port_note: Three successive connections on this same installed tuple; one cold bring-up, no register clear or reseed.
traffic.start_delay_note: maximum pre-connect delay in ms; each trial applies a seeded uniform draw in 0..N (seed = seeds.rng_seed + trial number, recorded). 0 = connect immediately.
